compiled_state.title: [sprint auto-resume]: epic with 11 open tasks counted as ACTIVE=0 -> resume skips unfinished work
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** b6745995ec01a4f6547628481fe7aa911dc7938b
* **plugin cache:** dso-dev 1.17.106
* **skill:** /dso:sprint Phase A auto-resume (skills/sprint/prompts/auto-resume.md), also Preplanning Gate Step 1 (skills/sprint/SKILL.md)

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** Sub-Agent Blocker / Workflow correctness defect

#### Expected Behavior

When resuming an in_progress epic, auto-resume.md clause (b) counts active (open + in_progress) children to decide the resume route. The epic waxen-sigma (canonical 99f1-153c) has 11 open task children + 1 closed + 1 deleted. The count should be 11, routing to clause (d) (ACTIVE > 0 -> resume task execution via Phase C).

CLAUDE.md contract: a ticket alias is "accepted anywhere a native ID is accepted." So `--parent=waxen-sigma` must return the same children as `--parent=99f1-153c`.

#### Actual Behavior

ACTIVE was computed as 0, which routes to clause (c) (all children closed -> skip to Phase G validation / or Preplanning Gate), SKIPPING the 11 unfinished tasks. Two independent root causes combine:

ROOT CAUSE A — alias not resolved by --parent filter:
```
$ .claude/scripts/dso ticket list --parent=waxen-sigma --status=open
[]
$ .claude/scripts/dso ticket list --parent=99f1-153c --status=open
[{"ticket_id":"2298-45c0-...", ... 11 tasks ...}]
```
The alias 'waxen-sigma' returns an empty array; the canonical ID returns the 11 tasks. Since Phase A sets primary_ticket_id to the user-selected value (the alias, when the user picks by number), --parent receives the alias and silently returns [].

ROOT CAUSE B — grep -c '"ticket_id"' undercounts single-line JSON:
The list CLI emits a single-line JSON array. auto-resume.md and the Preplanning Gate count children with `grep -c '"ticket_id"'`, which counts matching LINES (1), not occurrences. True occurrence count via `grep -o '"ticket_id"' | wc -l` is 11.
```
$ .claude/scripts/dso ticket list --parent=99f1-153c --status=open | grep -c '"ticket_id"'
1
$ .claude/scripts/dso ticket list --parent=99f1-153c --status=open | grep -o '"ticket_id"' | wc -l
11
$ .claude/scripts/dso ticket list --parent=99f1-153c --status=open | wc -l
1
```
Either defect alone breaks the count; with the alias they compound to [] -> 0.

### 3. Action History

1. /dso:sprint invoked with no arg; user selected epic #1 (waxen-sigma, in_progress).
2. Phase A routed to auto-resume.md; clause (b) ran ACTIVE=$({ list --parent=waxen-sigma --status=open; list --parent=waxen-sigma --status=in_progress; } | grep -c '"ticket_id"').
3. ACTIVE=0 reported despite 11 open task children confirmed via per-ticket `ticket show`.

### 5. Skills and Workflows

* skills/sprint/prompts/auto-resume.md clauses (b)/(c)
* skills/sprint/SKILL.md Preplanning Gate Step 1 (same grep -c pattern + OPEN/ALL counters)
* Both consume the line-based grep count; the Preplanning Gate ALSO uses it, so a non-resumed epic with 0 open / N closed could misroute too.

#### Impact

A resumed sprint with outstanding work silently skips to validation/closure instead of executing remaining tasks — high-impact correctness defect on the resume path. The operator only catches it by cross-checking per-ticket status manually (as happened here).

comments.body: Partial staleness note (2026-06-03): ROOT CAUSE B's counting mechanics were superseded by the bug-2b01 fix (merged to main via PR #609, commit 852e3ea6ab) — auto-resume.md clause (b) now uses a single 'ticket list --status=open,in_progress' call with a python json-length count instead of the brace-group + grep -c pattern. ROOT CAUSE A (alias not resolved by --parent: '--parent=waxen-sigma' returns [] while '--parent=99f1-153c' returns the 11 children) is NOT fixed and still yields ACTIVE=0 for alias-selected epics. Ticket remains open on root cause A.
